run_flask_viz_server: run the flask visualization server on port 5012 to compare image captions side by side
extract_captions_from_logs: extract captions from log.txt files in subdirectories by walking a folder path and choosing a line index
render_caption_comparison_page: render the index page that displays COCO images with ground truth, MeaCap, and custom captions
serve_coco_images: serve COCO val2014 image files from the configured images directory via the flask route
load_meacap_captions: load MeaCap model output captions from a JSON file and map them to COCO image IDs
